guide.summary: Mughal tombs, forts and riverside gardens, with hotel restaurants, bars, cafés and petha shops checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: The Taj Mahal and the Taj Museum inside its complex are closed on Fridays, so plan Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri or the Sikandara tombs for that day; the ASI lists Friday ticket rates for those.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.value: Taj Mahal and Taj Museum: Fridays
toolkit.copy: The Taj Mahal and the Taj Museum in its Western Jal Mahal are closed on Fridays, when the Taj mosque opens only for prayer. The ASI lists Friday ticket rates for Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: The Taj Mahal's official site lists ₹1,100 for foreign visitors and ₹50 for Indian visitors, plus an optional ₹200 for the main mausoleum, with children under 15 free. Online tickets cost ₹50 less for foreign visitors and ₹5 less for Indian visitors.

toolkit.label: Bag rules
toolkit.copy: The ASI prohibits food, big bags and briefcases, drones, tripods without prior ASI permission, torches and helmets at the Taj Mahal. Entry is from the Eastern Gate after a security check.

toolkit.label: Dining rules
toolkit.copy: Esphahan at The Oberoi Amarvilas asks for smart casual dress and welcomes children above eight; its reservation form promises a reply within 12 hours. Anise at Courtyard by Marriott Agra opens only October through March.

guide.dek: Put the Taj Mahal on any day but Friday, book its tickets online, and keep Friday for Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri or Sikandara.
intro: The Taj Mahal sits on the right bank of the Yamuna, and the ASI says you enter from the Eastern Gate after a security check. It is closed on Fridays. The monument's official site lists ₹1,100 for foreign visitors and ₹50 for Indian visitors, with an optional ₹200 to enter the main mausoleum and free entry for children under 15. Booking online through the ASI portals saves ₹50 per foreign ticket. Inside the complex, the Taj Museum in the Western Jal Mahal is free, though it shares the Friday closure.

Agra Fort stands on the same bank of the river, and the ASI lists Friday ticket rates for it and for Fatehpur Sikri, which makes them a good Friday plan. The older ASI Agra Circle pages give sunrise to sunset as opening hours for these monuments, so check before an early start. A ₹500 Agra Development Authority ticket for foreign visitors covers Agra Fort, Itimad-ud-Daulah's Tomb, Akbar's Tomb at Sikandara and Fatehpur Sikri on the same day. Across the river, Mehtab Bagh faces the Taj from the opposite bank.

For a quieter half-day, head out along the Agra-Mathura road to Akbar's Tomb and Mariam's Tomb, which stands to its west, or to Itimad-ud-Daulah's Tomb beside Chini-ka-Rauza on the left bank. Ram Bagh is getting new visitor amenities, according to a 2026 ASI tender. Pack light for the Taj: the ASI bans food, big bags, drones and tripods without permission. Panchhi Petha has branches near the Taj East Gate and at Atam Market in Sadar Bazaar, and Bakehouse Fairfield sells pastries and coffee daily from 11:30 am.

Most of Agra's sit-down dining is in hotels near the Taj. At The Oberoi Amarvilas, Esphahan serves Mughal recipes and tandoor breads; it asks for smart casual dress and welcomes children above eight. Bellevue there is the all-day restaurant, and The Lounge looks toward the Taj Mahal. ITC Mughal runs Peshawri and the Maikhana lobby bar, Grand Mercure Agra has the rooftop SkyGrill with Taj views, and Courtyard by Marriott Agra's Onyx Bar opens daily from 1 pm. The Oberoi's own bar is closed while it is reimagined.
summaryCards: Book the Taj Mahal online for any day except Friday, then add Agra Fort on the same Yamuna bank.
Start with breakfast at MoMo Café from 6:30 am, then walk the Taj Museum, which is free and closed on Fridays.
Keep Friday for Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri or Sikandara, since the Taj Mahal and Taj Museum close that day, and reserve Esphahan ahead in smart casual dress.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and ticket details do not guarantee availability. The ASI Agra Circle monument pages carry a 2013 copyright and some outdated notices, so their sunrise-to-sunset hours and fees are attributed rather than treated as current; tajmahal.gov.in is undated, and its night-viewing hours (8:00 pm to 11:59 pm) conflict with ASI's (8:30 pm to 12:30 am), so night viewing is not detailed in the copy. Opening hours were not published for the ITC Mughal outlets, Trident Agra, Grand Mercure Agra outlets or Panchhi Petha stores. Esphahan's page lists both 7 am to 10:30 pm and a weekend lunch slot while the hotel FAQ says dinner. Sites that couldn't be read: tajhotels.com, radissonhotels.com and hilton.com (403), sarovarhotels.com (429), pinchofspice.in (failed fetch), dasaprakashagra.com (does not resolve), and Wildlife SOS visit pages (404). Sheroes Hangout, Kalakriti and Bhagat Halwai domains now point elsewhere. Marriott pages began returning 403 late in the review after the Courtyard and Fairfield dining pages had been read.
